environment.description: AWS Lambda behind API Gateway (REST API) with CloudFront distribution. Secrets Manager secret has automatic rotation configured via Lambda rotator with RotationSchedule of rate(60 seconds) using AWSCURRENT/AWSPENDING staging labels. The rotation Lambda generates a new client_secret on each invocation and updates the HMAC signing material. DynamoDB auth_codes table has TTL of 300s. CloudFront distribution has a custom origin request policy that normalizes and validates the redirect_uri query parameter against a static allowlist stored in CloudFront Functions (not the Lambda's dynamic config). The CloudFront Function performs strict URL parsing with canonicalization (lowercasing scheme/host, removing default ports, resolving path traversal) before forwarding. API Gateway has a request validator requiring redirect_uri to match regex ^https://[a-z0-9.-]+\.example\.(com|org)/oauth/callback$ with no additional path segments or fragments allowed.
